tool_input.search_target: Determine the likely product for hydrolysis of methyl 4-[2-(9-phenyl-9H-fluoren-9-yl?)... substituted benzoate] represented by reactant SMILES COC(=O)c1ccc(C(C)(C)Oc2ccc3c(c2)C(c2ccccc2)=CC3)cc1, with NaOH in methanol, tetrahydrofuran, and water; identify whether the expected product is the carboxylic acid or carboxylate and provide its canonical SMILES.

from rdkit import Chem
s='COC(=O)c1ccc(C(C)(C)Oc2ccc3c(c2)C(c2ccccc2)=CC3)cc1'

for label,sm in [('acid','O=C(O)c1ccc(C(C)(C)Oc2ccc3c(c2)C(c2ccccc2)=CC3)cc1'),('carboxylate','O=C([O-])c1ccc(C(C)(C)Oc2ccc3c(c2)C(c2ccccc2)=CC3)cc1')]:
